visualReview.notes: All12 current portable views actually inspected in six combined sheets with the shared/context captures. Earlier12 draft views prompted stepped parapet/crest improvements; approval binds only to the current frames and hashes. Eight actual local exterior files individually inspected,67 primary candidate thumbnails and40 supplemental lighthouse/cellhouse thumbnails; three official HABS exterior/roof photos, the partial Citadel basement drawing and the official DOE later roof photograph inspected. Native three-part principal prison plan supplies staggered cellhouse wings, dining/kitchen and lower southeast administration envelope. Retains nine front bays, central recessed arched entrance/armorial envelope, stepped central parapet, two tiers of large gridded metal windows above smaller base lights, concrete pilasters/cornices and roof rods. Long glazed roof monitors, later blue PV rows/service aisles and integral broad cylindrical roof cistern with shallow conical cover distinguish the roof. Fine armorial relief, text, spalling, bars/security fixtures and exact solar inventory are generalized. No photograph pixels used as textures.

Yang2005public-domain original establishes the pale elevated main prison block, long regular exterior window rhythm, parapet/flat-roof silhouette and projecting northern dining/hospital wing relationship. Retained mapped native perimeter and architectural controls establish the fixed main prison scope; current representative southeast entrance/pilaster, side/dining/kitchen and roof renders were compared. Opposite/hidden facade detail, exact window counts, door and moulding dimensions, roof monitors and modern solar arrangement remain architectural medium-fi estimates; the2005photo does not demonstrate later solar installation or current restoration finish. Industrial/laundry buildings, chimney, water tower, lighthouse, warden ruins, island embankments and surrounding structures are excluded from this separate prison asset. Interior cells, signs, literal text and photo textures are omitted. Accepted at the agreed approximate medium-fi exterior scope. No reference pixels are embedded. Previously used attribution/private imagery is excluded from this current review.
